prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it, check its properties, move to target. Else, scan area for target. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveToTarget    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsTargetVisible    />     <Action ID = MoveToTarget    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForTarget    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToTarget
	END
